lines.rookie: Bongsu's note led to the Emperor's letter in the old pine. It left the palace unseen and reached the envoy Yi Jun. In 1907 three envoys went to The Hague. They went to tell the world the 1905 treaty was forced. They were not let into the conference. Yi Jun died in The Hague. Japan used the envoys as an excuse to force the Emperor off his throne.
lines.junior: Bongsu's note led to the Emperor's letter, hidden in the old pine. The letter left the palace unseen and reached the envoy Yi Jun. In 1907 three envoys went to The Hague to tell the world the 1905 treaty was forced. They were not let into the conference. Yi Jun died in The Hague. Japan used the envoys as an excuse to force the Emperor off his throne.
lines.master: Bongsu's note pointed the way to the Emperor's letter in the old pine; it slipped out of the palace unseen and reached the envoy Yi Jun. In 1907 three envoys travelled to The Hague to tell the world the 1905 treaty was forced, but they were not let into the conference. Yi Jun died in The Hague. Japan used the envoys as an excuse to force the Emperor off his throne.

lines.rookie:
The watchers stand at the big front gate all day.
First, walk behind the library hall.
Do not cross the throne hall's yard: everyone sees it.
After the library, cross the garden by the old well.
Then go out by the little west gate. My uncle keeps it.
Last, walk down the lane by the stone wall.

The watchers stand at the big front gate all day long.
First, walk behind the library hall.
Do not cross the throne hall's yard. Everyone can see it.
After the library, cross the garden by the old well.
Then leave by the little west gate. My uncle guards it.
Last, walk down the lane by the stone wall.

The watchers keep to the big front gate all day.
First, slip behind the library hall.
Do not cross the throne hall's yard: every eye can see it.
After the library, cross the garden by the old well.
Then go out by the little west gate, which my uncle keeps.
Last, walk down the lane by the stone wall.
